_comment: DATA-ONLY WATCHLIST (added 2026-09-13) — see watchlist_eodhd.json for why these names are held out of M1. Fetched every night by fetch_nasdaq.py in the nasdaq pod, before the main pass, into data_nasdaq/watchlist/{SEP,SF1,ACTIONS,SFP}/<T>.json; build_m1 and validate read data_nasdaq/{SEP,SF1,ACTIONS}/*.json only. No whole tables here: TICKERS/SP500 and the survivorship-free _ALL pulls already cover every name in the main pass. Windows start 1990, below the bundle's ~1998 floor, so every name's full available history lands. A universe this small fits one ticker list, so warm runs filter server-side instead of taking the unfiltered bulk pull.
_funds_comment: SPY/QQQ are ETFs, which Sharadar files in the `funds` table (SFP), NOT SEP: in `stocks` they return 0 SEP rows, and an empty file pins the whole table to the cold path every night. SFP is served to this Core US Equities key (verified live 2026-09-13; QQQ reaches its 1999-03-10 listing).
